one_line: Queen of Sivaganga who led a regional resistance against East India Company power in late-18th-century Tamil Nadu.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to mid-30s, athletic and wiry with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a warm brown Tamil complexion, strong straight nose, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, a small bindi, and a composed, commanding default expression that softens slightly at the eyes.
appearance.hair: Long black hair oiled and drawn back into a thick, low bun at the nape wrapped in white jasmine strands, with a narrow gold maang tikka at the center part and a deep-red cloth turban-like headwrap (simple valvai style) tied over the crown, leaving some hair visible at the back.
appearance.costume: She wears an 18th-century Tamil warrior-queen outfit: a deep indigo cotton sari with a broad maroon border, draped in a practical madisar-like wrap that is firmly pleated and brought between the legs to form a riding-friendly lower garment, over a fully covering half-sleeve maroon cotton blouse; over this she has a fitted, sleeveless dark-brown leather jerkin/vest and a plain steel breastplate that is modest and functional, with a wide cloth kamarbandh belt in mustard yellow tying the torso and holding a small pouch; her feet are in simple brown leather sandals, and she wears modest gold jewellery—thin bangles on each wrist, small round earrings, a plain nose stud, and a single long gold chain with a subtle thali-like pendant kept tucked close to the chest.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved South Indian steel sword with a simple brass hilt and no handguard, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard at her left hip, which she often holds drawn in her right hand.

ref_desc: Rani Velu Nachiyar is a late-20s athletic Tamil queen with warm brown skin, sharp dark eyes, a small bindi, long black hair in a jasmine-wrapped low bun under a deep-red cloth headwrap, wearing an indigo sari with maroon border in practical warrior drape over a maroon blouse, a dark-brown leather jerkin with modest steel breastplate, mustard cloth belt, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a curved South Indian steel sword with a brass hilt and brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Rani Velu Nachiyar, a late-20s athletic Tamil queen with warm brown skin, an oval face, strong straight nose, thick brows, sharp dark eyes, and a small bindi, wearing a calm but commanding expression; her long black hair is oiled and pulled into a thick low bun at the nape wrapped in white jasmine strands, with a narrow gold maang tikka at the center part and a deep-red cloth headwrap tied over the crown so that some hair and flowers show at the back. She is dressed in an 18th-century Tamil warrior-queen outfit: a deep indigo cotton sari with a broad maroon border, draped in a practical, modest madisar-like style that creates secure, trouser-like folds for riding, over a fully covering half-sleeve maroon cotton blouse; over this she wears a fitted, sleeveless dark-brown leather jerkin and a plain, modest steel breastplate shaped simply to cover the torso. A mustard yellow cloth belt is wrapped firmly around her waist, holding a small pouch. Her feet are in simple brown leather sandals. She has modest gold jewellery: thin bangles on each wrist, small round earrings, a plain nose stud, and a single long gold chain with a subtle pendant lying close to her chest. Her signature weapon is a slightly curved South Indian steel sword with a simple brass hilt and no handguard, housed in a plain brown leather scabbard at her left hip; show her holding the drawn sword in her right hand with the scabbard visible at her side. Use a color palette of deep indigo, maroon, mustard yellow, dark brown, and steel grey, and present her in a neutral stance with front, side, and back views to clearly show face, hair, costume, and weapon details.
